World Cup — Historical Results & Odds

Home / Database / Leagues / World Cup — Historical Results & Odds

Explore World Cup historical results and odds in one place. This database covers the current season and the last seasons with filters and downloads. Switch between views to analyse Overview, Scores, Corners & Cards, Attack & Possession, Expected Goals (xG) and Odds.

  • Filter by date, team, goals, corners, cards, shots, ball possession, odds, referee, and more.
  • Download any filtered view to CSV/Excel.
  • Ideal for research: historical odds, 1X2, Over/Under Goals, BTTS, and match stats.

Tip: start with the Current Season for speed, then switch to Last Seasons when you need the full historical dataset.
